discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators (the quantum spin Hall effect)
rationale: Recent prizes covered AI (2024) and superconducting quantum circuits (2025), so condensed matter is due. Topological insulators are a mature, foundational field with a clear theory-plus-experiment trio. Kane and Mele predicted the Z2 quantum spin Hall phase, and Molenkamp's HgTe quantum-well experiment confirmed it. Shoucheng Zhang died in 2018, which simplifies the laureate selection. The 2016 topology prize was for theory, which leaves room for this materials-focused follow-up.
